review.scopeLimit: This focal attestation closes the shared Retry semantics contract and exact same-attachment recovery through the Android, Web and iOS Chat playback adapters. A rendered Compose failure surface and native Retry click, physical microphone, routing and exhaustive outage matrices remain separate.

notes: The shared source keeps the same attachment selected, maps the failed toggle to localized Retry semantics and does not render internal transport reasons; the evidence does not claim a rendered Compose UI observation.
Android retries the same remote descriptor after resolver failure and invokes native load only with recovered local bytes.
Web serializes load/stop ownership, refuses to discard a Blob lease after failed native stop and releases a newly materialized lease when native load fails or throws cancellation.
iOS retries the same descriptor through its authenticated bounded downloader and discards only the recovered temporary file after successful native stop.
